title: I Heard the Voice of Jesus Say
lyrics_original: I heard the voice of Jesus say,
"Come unto Me and rest;
Lay down, O weary one, lay down
Your head upon My breast."
I came to Jesus as I was
So weary, worn, and sad;
I found in Him a resting place
And He has made me glad.
I heard the voice of Jesus say,
"Behold, I freely give
The living water, thirsty one,
Stoop down and drink and live."
I came to Jesus, and I drank
Of that life-giving stream;
My thirst was quenched, my soul revived,
And now I live in Him.
I heard the voice of Jesus say,
"I am this dark world's light;
Look unto Me, your morn shall rise,
And all your day be bright."
I looked to Jesus and I found
In Him my star, my sun;
And in that light of life I'll walk
Till traveling days are done.

bible_verses.english: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
Everything new the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me, I will in no way throw out.
My soul waits in silence for God alone. My salvation comes from him.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, I come to You today just as I am—weary, worn, and in need of Your tender care. Thank You for inviting me to lay down my heavy burdens and find my true rest in You. Refresh my soul with Your living water and fill my heart with the joy of Your presence. Teach me to quiet my mind and lean fully upon Your boundless love. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Jesus does not ask us to fix ourselves before we draw near to Him; He simply invites us to come as we are. When life leaves us exhausted, heavy-hearted, and thirsty for peace, His voice gently calls us into a rest that only He can provide. As we lay down our burdens at His feet, we discover that His presence is a welcoming sanctuary for our weary souls. May this song remind you today that you can step out of the striving and rest securely in the Savior's gladness and living grace.
